statement.en: A positive delta EVE or delta NII is a loss; only losses are aggregated across currencies.
statement.es: Un delta EVE o delta NII positivo es una pérdida; solo las pérdidas se agregan entre monedas.

notice.en: The call-report aggregates are the bank's own, read from the FDIC BankFind financials. Every behavioural assumption (deposit core share and maturity, prepayment, term-deposit redemption, the slotting of the report bands) is synthetic and stated in the document.
notice.es: Los agregados del reporte son los del banco, leídos de los estados financieros de FDIC BankFind. Todo supuesto de comportamiento (proporción y plazo estables de los depósitos, prepago, rescate de depósitos a plazo, la distribución de las bandas del reporte) es sintético y está declarado en el documento.

rule.en: Call reports are read only up to the valuation date; later reports are never read for the valuation (only the out-of-sample row reads the realised year).
rule.es: Los reportes se leen solo hasta la fecha de valoración; los posteriores nunca se leen para la valoración (solo la fila fuera de muestra lee el año realizado).

curve.source: US Treasury daily par yield curve (Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates), observation date 2022-12-30; carried to 2022-12-31, the last curve published on or before it
curve.interpolation: par yields bootstrapped to continuously compounded zero rates (the engine's zero-curve bootstrap, semiannual bond-equivalent, simple interest up to six months); linear in tenor and flat outside the grid at the 19 midpoints

nmd_core_share.source: balance-weighted average of the used values of the deposit categories below (the SRP31 Table 4 caps applied to the synthetic requests)

nmd_core_maturity_years.source: balance-weighted average of the used values of the deposit categories below

prepayment_cpr.source: Stated by Contraste (synthetic): the call report has no loan-level prepayment history. Applied to the amortising mortgage items (residential loans repricing beyond three months, mortgage-backed securities) in the behavioural flows; the SRP31.119 multipliers are tabled in the models document, not applied per shock.

term_deposit_redemption_rate.source: Stated by Contraste (synthetic): the baseline early-redemption rate TDRR0 of SRP31.125, scaled by the Table 6 multiplier of each shock.

deposit_beta.source: Fitted per valuation date on the quarterly cost of deposits (deposit interest expense over average deposits) against the 3-month Treasury par yield, last 16 quarters up to the date, slope through the origin on the quarters with a rising market rate (up) and a falling one (down). Up 0.2611 on 7 quarters, down 0.0315 on 9; the dynamic NII uses the up value.

nmd_segments.source: Request stated by Contraste (synthetic); the call report carries no behavioural assumption. Used value: the SRP31 Table 4 cap when the request exceeds it.

tests.h0: the engine reproduces the SRP31.92 worked example within the printed precision
tests.alternative: the engine departs from the printed values
tests.reference: BCBS SRP31.90 to SRP31.92, Interest rate risk in the banking book, the six standardised shock scenarios and the worked example at t = 3.5 years (dossier 01 H.2), https://www.bis.org/basel_framework/chapter/SRP/31.htm

tests.h0: the EVE of the balance sheet equals the sum of the EVEs of its items
tests.alternative: the aggregated EVE differs from the sum of its parts
tests.reference: BCBS SRP31.82 to SRP31.83 and SRP31.129: the EVE supervisory outlier test (15 percent of Tier 1) and the standardised EVE; dossier 05 D.7: always report EVE with and without behavioural assumptions

tests.h0: the behavioural assumptions do not change the EVE risk measure materially and hide no breach
tests.alternative: the behavioural assumptions move the EVE risk measure materially or hide a breach
tests.reference: BCBS SRP31.82 to SRP31.83 and SRP31.129: the EVE supervisory outlier test (15 percent of Tier 1) and the standardised EVE; dossier 05 D.7: always report EVE with and without behavioural assumptions

tests.h0: the replicating-portfolio weights are stable across estimation windows
tests.alternative: the weights move between consecutive windows by more than the gap
tests.reference: BCBS d368 (2016), Standards: Interest rate risk in the banking book, https://www.bis.org/bcbs/publ/d368.htm; dossier 05 D.3 (weight stability across estimation windows)

tests.h0: no change of a behavioural parameter coincides with a limit breach
tests.alternative: a behavioural parameter changed at a date where a limit was breached
tests.reference: dossier 05 D.7: flag any change in NMD behavioural parameters that coincides with a limit breach (the SVB lesson)

tests.h0: the projected change of NII matches the realised change
tests.alternative: the projected change of NII departs from the realised change
tests.reference: dossier 05, IRRBB acceptance: the 2022 hiking cycle as the out-of-sample test of an NII projection
tests.notes: not evaluated: the realised change in NII is not available

title.en: The EVE risk measure is 18.1 percent of Tier 1 with the capped behavioural NMD and 64.6 percent with every non-maturity deposit overnight; the outlier threshold is 15 percent.
title.es: La medida de riesgo EVE es 18,1 por ciento del capital de nivel 1 con NMD conductual con tope y 64,6 por ciento con todos los depósitos a la vista a un día; el umbral de la prueba es 15 por ciento.

title.en: The split of deposits between retail and wholesale and every core share and maturity are synthetic: the call report carries none.
title.es: La separación de depósitos entre minoristas y mayoristas y toda proporción y plazo estables son sintéticos: el reporte no los trae.

title.en: The fitted replicating-portfolio weights move by up to 0.52 between estimation windows and the weighted average maturity by up to 2.6 years: the deposit duration the data support is not stable.
title.es: Los pesos de la cartera replicante ajustada se mueven hasta 0,52 entre ventanas de estimación y el plazo promedio ponderado hasta 2,6 años: la duración de los depósitos que respaldan los datos no es estable.

title.en: The fitted weighted average maturity changed at 2 dates where the standardised outlier test was breached: a deposit-duration assumption that moves with a breach is the pattern the Federal Reserve review describes.
title.es: El plazo promedio ponderado ajustado cambió en 2 fechas en que se superó la prueba de valores atípicos estandarizada: un supuesto de duración de depósitos que se mueve con un exceso es el patrón que describe la revisión de la Reserva Federal.
